error_msg: The parameters for MultiOutputRegression must include one or more of ['fit_intercept', 'copy_X', 'n_jobs', 'positive'].
description: MultiOutputRegression trains an independent regressor for each output. By default, it uses LinearRegression for each output.

oneOf.error_msg: The 'fit_intercept' parameter must be of type boolean.
oneOf.description: Determines whether to calculate the intercept for this model.

oneOf.error_msg: The 'copy_X' parameter must be of type boolean.
oneOf.description: Determines whether to copy the input matrix X.

oneOf.error_msg: The 'n_jobs' parameter must be an integer or null.
oneOf.description: The number of jobs to use for computation. -1 means using all processors.

oneOf.error_msg: The 'positive' parameter must be of type boolean.
oneOf.description: When set to True, forces the coefficients to be positive.
